cover_headline: Hot CPI lifts the Aussie, trims tech
cover_subhead: August inflation came in above forecasts, sending the dollar higher and rate-sensitive tech lower into the close.
cover_pullquote: Our read: November is now live for the RBA, and the market knows it.
big_story_headline: A hot inflation print puts a November RBA hike firmly on the table
big_story_intro: The ASX 200 slipped 0.3% as CPI beat forecasts, with tech and property lagging while banks held firm. The Aussie dollar reclaimed 70 US cents, and tonight the focus shifts to US PCE inflation.
big_story_outro: Tonight's PCE decides whether US yields push higher still.
pineapple_take_quote: The RBA isn't finished, and today's tape just said so out loud.
pineapple_take_body: A stronger dollar and weaker tech on the same day is the market pricing another hike. We'd expect rate-sensitive names to stay heavy until the November meeting, unless tonight's US data cools yields fast.
